prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Home maintenance". Read it with fetch before each change. When I tell you about a recurring job, add a row to the table with edit: Task, Every, Last done and Next due as yyyy-mm-dd. At the start of a month, when I ask, add what's due this month under "This month" as a checklist. When I say I've done one, update its Last done and Next due and tick it. Keep model numbers and warranty dates I mention under "Appliances".
